# opnsense_acmeclient_settings (Data Source)

Reads ACME Client plugin settings from the upstream system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_acmeclient_settings" "current" {}

output "acmeclient_enabled" {
  value = data.opnsense_acmeclient_settings.current.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `auto_renewal` (Boolean) Whether automatic certificate renewal is enabled.
- `challenge_port` (String) Local HTTP-01 challenge port.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the ACME Client plugin is enabled.
- `environment` (String) Let's Encrypt environment (`prod` or `stg`).
- `id` (String) Always set to `acmeclient_settings`.
- `log_level` (String) Acme.sh log level.
- `restart_timeout` (String) Seconds to wait for restart actions after issuance or renewal.
- `tls_challenge_port` (String) Local TLS-ALPN-01 challenge port.
